payload.title: Opinion-claims study: review and publish the real results page
payload.description:
Review the completed opinion-claims study results and site presentation; publish only evidence-backed results for the engines actually measured. Definition of done: the rendered Opinion & belief page identifies the measured models dynamically, presents the recorded outcomes without false precision, and the focused site and replay checks pass.

Feature: published opinion-claim results
Scenario: visitor opens the opinion-claims page
Given replayable answers and scored records for the measured engines
When the site is built
Then the page presents the real measured engines and results without hardcoded model claims.
